## Core Capabilities & Features
1. **Full 1080p MP4 Video:** Extracts highest quality direct streaming manifests without screen recording artifacts or watermarks.
2. **Direct Hongguoduanju Link Support:** Instantly parses `hongguoduanju.com` web URLs, mobile app share text, and drama IDs without browser redirects.
3. **Batch Whole-Series Queue:** Download 50 to 100+ episodes in one single click with multi-threaded speed.
4. **AI-Generated Dramas (AI 短剧):** Full native support for downloading all AI short-drama titles from Hongguo.
5. **No Android Emulator Required:** Standalone Windows 10/11 application (~88 MB installer). No BlueStacks, Nox, Python, or ffmpeg needed.
6. **Privacy & Security:** Runs guest mode requests locally; no ByteDance login credentials needed. State integrity protected by machine-bound HMAC signatures.
7. **Clean Installation Support:** Integrated installer option flushes stale browser & WebView cache on update while strictly preserving active licenses.
8. **Auto-Updating Library:** Scans and downloads missing newly-released episodes with one click.
